failures_and_remediation.root_cause: Official search button uses sensyuSearchExec() and hidden PJ0501_02SubmitForm GET /pc/racersearchresult; v1 incorrectly submitted visible controls to /pc/search and expected plain racerprofile href links.
failures_and_remediation.remediation: Live semantic probes bound official two-form search route and sensyuLink(snum) result semantics; locator v3 consumes search-result name+snum only.

failures_and_remediation.root_cause: Allowed PRE clips contain no usable meeting-date text; internal Reiwa-date assumption was false.
failures_and_remediation.remediation: Bind event day to official Tamano discovery exact href YYYYMMDD prefix plus exact raw SHA-256 of parsed bytes; do not extract date from POST/full-document regions.

failures_and_remediation.root_cause: (7車立) marker is immediately below entrant row block, outside prior row ymax.
failures_and_remediation.remediation: PRE-only mapping of all 12 markers established dedicated narrow marker band x=ox+60..150, y=ymax..ymax+30; entrant extraction region was not widened.

failures_and_remediation.failure: QUARANTINE_FAIL_CLOSED frozen supplement parse: update timestamp
failures_and_remediation.root_cause: Old profile parser globally de-duplicated datetime strings then assigned first/second; section ownership was not explicit and identical timestamps across sections could collapse.
failures_and_remediation.remediation: Profile parser v4 binds one unique timestamp between semantic section label and owned target table; DOM row ownership permits tbody but excludes nested layout-table recursion.

failures_and_remediation.failure: Nested layout table duplicate / over-strict direct-child table detection
failures_and_remediation.root_cause: Outer layout table recursively contained semantic rows, while tbody prevented direct-child-only detection.
failures_and_remediation.remediation: A row belongs to table T iff its nearest parent table is T; cells similarly use nearest parent row ownership.

failures_and_remediation.failure: Frozen rule required exact canonical class match but executable canonical Japanese-label mapping was not bound.
failures_and_remediation.root_cause: Tamano emits SS/S1/S2/A1/A2/A3/L1 while KEIRIN profile displays full-width Japanese labels such as Ｓ級Ｓ班 and Ａ級２班.
failures_and_remediation.remediation: Fusion guard v2 implements only the explicit deterministic seven-label canonical mapping, plus frozen score 0.01 and quinella fraction 0.001 checks; unknown class labels fail closed.

failures_and_remediation.failure: Per-rider resolver architecture could reset limiter and had no race-wide timing proof.
failures_and_remediation.root_cause: Seven independent locators do not prove one shared >=5s provider interval or <=120s whole-source window.
failures_and_remediation.remediation: Race batch v3 uses one session/limiter, one search per unique pref+term, one profile fetch per rider, <=90s batch and <=120s whole-source-window fail-closed gates.
